sections.heading: What is Month-Over-Month Growth?
paragraphs: Month-over-month (MoM) growth measures the percentage change in a specific metric from one month to the next. It's a critical indicator used by businesses to understand quick changes in market conditions, operational results, and overall performance trajectories.
MoM calculations are commonly used across business functions including finance (revenue monitoring), marketing (follower growth), sales (customer acquisition), and production (volume tracking).

bullets.label: Identify Short-term Trends
bullets.text: Detect changes that aren't apparent from longer periods, allowing rapid adaptation

bullets.label: Spot Seasonal Patterns
bullets.text: Understand cyclicality for inventory, staffing, and marketing planning

bullets.label: Set Measurable Targets
bullets.text: Provides actionable KPIs to motivate teams and align efforts

bullets.label: Startup Validation
bullets.text: Evaluate whether products are gaining market traction

bullets.label: Distress Monitoring
bullets.text: Track if business is improving or deteriorating for strategic decisions
